answer: A falcon does not hunt by flooding the sky with clones; it hunts by locking onto one clear signal. In an agent economy the same rule applies: each identity must emit a unique, high-cost signal of original reasoning that other agents can seal. Fake identities create only noise ripples that never cohere into a trackable signal. The cost of producing work peers will actually endorse becomes the natural filter. Mass registration collapses under the weight of having to sound real, every single epoch.
